---
title: "Hazelnut data explorer"
title-tr: "Fındık veri gezgini"
description: "Every monthly hazelnut price record from the Giresun and Ordu commodity exchanges, filtered in the browser and downloadable as Excel."
description-tr: "Giresun ve Ordu ticaret borsalarının bütün aylık fındık fiyatı kayıtları; tarayıcıda filtreleyip Excel olarak indirebilirsiniz."

```{python}
from hazelnut.site import i18n
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, SITE_URL, load_crops
from hazelnut.site.crops import crop_module
from hazelnut.site.i18n import t
from hazelnut.site.labels import scroll_hint

crop = load_crops()["hazelnut"]
mod = crop_module(crop.slug)
data_dir = SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug
manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(data_dir / "manifest.json")
local = crop.local_currency

# Filters, files, labels and number formats all come from the crop config and the workbook spec.
cfg = ph.explorer_config(crop, mod.WORKBOOK_SHEETS, mod.EXPLORER_SHEETS, mod.WORKBOOK_SOURCES,
                         f"../data/{crop.slug}")

# The line under the table for each other exchange: months far from the first exchange's
# price (most likely source entry errors), which the explorer still shows as published.
def _frame(name):
    return ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / mod.WORKBOOK_SHEETS[mod.EXPLORER_SHEETS[name]][0],
                               required=("month", local.column))

notes = {}
if cfg["exchanges"]:
    ref_name = cfg["exchanges"][0]["name"]
    ref = _frame(ref_name)
    href = "analyses/exchanges.html" if "exchanges" in crop.analyses else None
    for ex in cfg["exchanges"][1:]:
        other = _frame(ex["name"])
        if ref is not None and other is not None:
            note = ph.explorer_outlier_note(ref, other, local.column, ex["name"], ref_name, href)
            if note:
                notes[ex["name"]] = note

cfg.update(
    notes=notes,
    as_of=ph.month_label(manifest["as_of"]) if manifest else None,
    downloads_url=f"{SITE_URL}downloads.html",
    unavailable="These records could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.",
    empty="No months match these filters.",
    scroll_hint=scroll_hint(),
)
ojs_define(explorer=cfg)

stamp = ""
if manifest is not None:
    stamp = (f'<span class="live"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>'
             f'{ph.escape(ph.as_of_stamp(manifest))}</span>')
ph.raw_html(
    '<div class="dash-head"><div>'
    f'<span class="eyebrow">{ph.escape(t("explorer.eyebrow", crop=i18n.crop_name(crop)))}</span>'
    f'<h1>{ph.escape(t("explorer.h1"), quote=False)}</h1></div>'
    f"{stamp}</div>"
)
```

viewof extras = checkInput("Columns", exchangeCfg.extras.map(k => colOf(exchangeCfg, k)))

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// ---- data ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FileAttachment takes only literal paths, so this crop page names its monthly files here;
// which exchange reads which file still comes from the config (an exchange whose file is
// not listed shows the unavailable note).
attachments = new Map([
  ["../data/hazelnut/prices_monthly.csv", FileAttachment("../data/hazelnut/prices_monthly.csv")],
  ["../data/hazelnut/ordu_monthly.csv", FileAttachment("../data/hazelnut/ordu_monthly.csv")],
])

data = {
  const out = new Map();
  await Promise.all(explorer.exchanges.map(async ex => {
    try {
      const raw = await attachments.get(ex.file).csv();
      const numeric = ex.columns.filter(c => c.decimals !== null).map(c => c.key);
      out.set(ex.name, raw.map(r => {
        const rec = {...r};
        for (const k of numeric) rec[k] = (r[k] === undefined || r[k] === "") ? null : +r[k];
        return rec;
      }));
    } catch (e) {
      out.set(ex.name, null);
    }
  }));
  for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(".records-skeleton")) el.remove();
  return out;
}

allSeasons = {
  const s = new Set();
  for (const rows of data.values()) for (const r of rows ?? []) if (r.season) s.add(r.season);
  return [...s].sort().reverse();  // "2025/26" labels sort by their start year; newest first
}

exchangeCfg = explorer.exchanges.find(e => e.name === exchange)
currencyCfg = explorer.currencies.find(c => c.label === currency)

columns = {
  const keep = new Set(extras);
  return [
    colOf(exchangeCfg, "month"),
    colOf(exchangeCfg, currencyCfg.column),
    ...exchangeCfg.extras.filter(k => keep.has(k)).map(k => colOf(exchangeCfg, k)),
  ].filter(Boolean);
}

rows = {
  const all = data.get(exchange);
  if (!all) return null;
  const keep = new Set(seasons);
  return all.filter(r => keep.has(r.season));
}

// ---- header, download and note ---------------------------------------------------------
recordsHead = (view, seasons, exchange) => {
  const n = view.length;
  const status = htl.html`<span class="dl-status" role="status"></span>`;
  const button = htl.html`<button type="button" class="btn pri" disabled=${n === 0}
      title=${n === 0 ? "Nothing to download: no months match these filters" : null}>
    <svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#download"/></svg>Download this view (.xlsx)</button>`;
  button.onclick = async () => {
    button.disabled = true;
    status.textContent = "Preparing the file…";
    try {
      await downloadView(view, columns);
      status.textContent = "";
    } catch (e) {
      status.textContent = e instanceof LoadError
        ? "The Excel library could not load. Check your connection and try again."
        : "The file could not be made. Please try again.";
    } finally {
      button.disabled = view.length === 0;
    }
  };
  return htl.html`<div class="phead records-head">
    <div><span class="eyebrow">Monthly records</span>
      <h2 class="ptitle">${exchange}, ${seasonsLabel(seasons)}</h2></div>
    <div class="records-actions">
      <span class="pill" aria-live="polite">${n.toLocaleString("en-US")} ${n === 1 ? "row" : "rows"}</span>
      ${button}${status}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

recordsNote = (exchange) => {
  const note = explorer.notes[exchange];
  if (!note) return htl.html`<span></span>`;
  const p = htl.html`<p class="foot"></p>`;
  p.innerHTML = note;  // built and escaped at render time from the site data
  return p;
}

fileName = {
  const token = seasonsToken(seasons);
  const slug = s => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
  return `${slug(explorer.slug)}-${slug(exchange)}-${token}.xlsx`;
}

downloadView = async (records, cols) => {
  const XLSX = await loadXLSX();
  const head = cols.map(c => c.label);
  const body = records.map(r => cols.map(c => xlsxCell(r[c.key], c)));
  const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([head, ...body]);
  ws["!cols"] = cols.map(c => ({wch: Math.max(c.label.length + 2, c.key === "month" ? 10 : 9)}));
  const about = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([
    [`${explorer.name} monthly records`],
    ["Exchange", exchange],
    ["Currency", currency],
    ["Seasons", [...seasons].sort().join(", ")],
    ["Rows", records.length],
    ["Data as of", explorer.as_of ?? "unknown"],
    ["Source", exchangeCfg.source ?? "See the Downloads page"],
    ["Credit and terms", exchangeCfg.terms ?? "See the Downloads page"],
    ["All sources and terms", explorer.downloads_url],
  ]);
  about["!cols"] = [{wch: 22}, {wch: 70}];
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, "Records");
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, about, "About");
  XLSX.writeFile(wb, fileName, {compression: true});
}

// ---- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]

colOf = (ex, key) => ex.columns.find(c => c.key === key)

fmtCell = (v, c) => {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || Number.isNaN(v)) return "";
  if (c.key === "month") return `${MONTHS[+v.slice(5, 7) - 1]} ${v.slice(0, 4)}`;
  if (c.decimals === null) return String(v);
  return v.toLocaleString("en-US", {minimumFractionDigits: c.decimals, maximumFractionDigits: c.decimals});
}

// One spreadsheet cell: months become real dates shown as "Sep 2026", numbers keep their
// full value with the table's number format, and missing values stay empty.
xlsxCell = (v, c) => {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || Number.isNaN(v)) return null;
  if (c.key === "month") {
    const serial = (Date.UTC(+v.slice(0, 4), +v.slice(5, 7) - 1, 1) - Date.UTC(1899, 11, 30)) / 864e5;
    return {t: "n", v: serial, z: "mmm yyyy"};
  }
  if (c.decimals === null) return {t: "s", v: String(v)};
  return {t: "n", v, z: c.decimals ? `0.${"0".repeat(c.decimals)}` : "0"};
}

seasonStart = s => +s.slice(0, 4)

isRun = list => {
  const ys = list.map(seasonStart).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return ys.every((y, i) => i === 0 || y === ys[i - 1] + 1);
}

seasonsLabel = list => {
  const s = [...list].sort();
  if (s.length === 0) return "no season selected";
  if (s.length === 1) return `season ${s[0]}`;
  if (s.length === allSeasons.length) return "all seasons";
  if (isRun(s)) return `seasons ${s[0]} to ${s[s.length - 1]}`;
  return `${s.length} seasons`;
}

seasonsToken = list => {
  const s = [...list].sort().map(x => x.replace("/", "-"));
  if (s.length === allSeasons.length) return "all-seasons";
  if (s.length === 1) return s[0];
  if (isRun(list)) return `${s[0]}-to-${s[s.length - 1]}`;
  return s.length <= 4 ? s.join("_") : `${s.length}-seasons`;
}

loadXLSX = {
  // SheetJS (write only) is fetched the first time someone downloads, never on page load.
  let pending = null;
  // The page has an AMD `define` (Observable's module loader), so SheetJS's UMD wrapper
  // registers itself there and leaves `window.XLSX` empty; finish it the way its AMD
  // factory would.
  const ready = () => {
    const X = window.XLSX;
    if (X && !X.version && typeof window.make_xlsx_lib === "function") window.make_xlsx_lib(X);
    return X && X.utils ? X : null;
  };
  return () => pending || (pending = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (ready()) return resolve(ready());
    const s = document.createElement("script");
    s.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js";
    s.integrity = "sha384-vtjasyidUo0kW94K5MXDXntzOJpQgBKXmE7e2Ga4LG0skTTLeBi97eFAXsqewJjw";
    s.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
    s.onload = () => ready() ? resolve(ready()) : reject(new LoadError("SheetJS loaded without its API"));
    s.onerror = () => { pending = null; s.remove(); reject(new LoadError("SheetJS failed to load")); };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }));
}

LoadError = class extends Error {}

// ---- inputs, styled by the site theme (no Observable Inputs) ----------------------------
segInput = (label, options) => {
  const name = `seg-${label.toLowerCase()}`;
  const el = htl.html`<fieldset class="field"><legend class="eyebrow">${label}</legend>
    <div class="seg">${options.map((o, i) => htl.html`<label class=${i === 0 ? "on" : null}>
      <input type="radio" class="visually-hidden" name=${name} value=${o} checked=${i === 0}>${o}</label>`)}</div>
  </fieldset>`;
  Object.defineProperty(el, "value", {get: () => el.querySelector("input:checked").value});
  el.addEventListener("input", () => {
    for (const l of el.querySelectorAll("label")) l.classList.toggle("on", l.querySelector("input").checked);
  });
  return el;
}

checkInput = (label, cols) => {
  const el = htl.html`<fieldset class="field"><legend class="eyebrow">${label}</legend>
    <div class="checks">${cols.map(c => htl.html`<label class="check">
      <input type="checkbox" value=${c.key} checked>${c.label}</label>`)}</div>
  </fieldset>`;
  Object.defineProperty(el, "value", {
    get: () => [...el.querySelectorAll("input:checked")].map(i => i.value),
  });
  return el;
}

seasonInput = (list) => {
  const picked = new Set(list.slice(0, 2));  // the newest two seasons: the latest months and one full season
  const el = htl.html`<fieldset class="field"><legend class="eyebrow">Season</legend>
    <div class="season-tools">
      <button type="button" data-pick="latest">Latest</button>
      <button type="button" data-pick="all">All</button>
      <button type="button" data-pick="none">None</button>
    </div>
    <div class="season-list" role="group" aria-label="Seasons, newest first">${list.map(s => htl.html`<label class="check">
      <input type="checkbox" value=${s} checked=${picked.has(s)}>${s}</label>`)}</div>
  </fieldset>`;
  Object.defineProperty(el, "value", {
    get: () => [...el.querySelectorAll(".season-list input:checked")].map(i => i.value),
  });
  for (const b of el.querySelectorAll("[data-pick]")) {
    b.onclick = () => {
      const how = b.dataset.pick;
      el.querySelectorAll(".season-list input").forEach((i, k) => {
        i.checked = how === "all" || (how === "latest" && k < 2);
      });
      el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    };
  }
  return el;
}

// ---- the table -------------------------------------------------------------------------
sortState = ({key: "month", dir: -1})  // newest month first; kept while the filters change

recordsTable = (records, cols) => {
  if (records === null) {
    const el = htl.html`<div class="chart-error" role="note">${explorer.unavailable}</div>`;
    el.value = [];
    return el;
  }
  if (records.length === 0) {
    const el = htl.html`<div class="chart-error records-empty" role="status">${explorer.empty}</div>`;
    el.value = [];
    return el;
  }
  if (!cols.some(c => c.key === sortState.key)) Object.assign(sortState, {key: "month", dir: -1});
  const wrap = htl.html`<div class="records-wrap" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Monthly records table" data-scroll-hint=${explorer.scroll_hint}>`;
  const sorted = () => {
    const {key, dir} = sortState;
    return [...records].sort((a, b) => {
      const x = a[key], y = b[key];
      const xm = x === null || x === "", ym = y === null || y === "";
      if (xm || ym) return xm && ym ? 0 : xm ? 1 : -1;  // blanks last either way
      return (x < y ? -1 : x > y ? 1 : 0) * dir;
    });
  };
  const draw = () => {
    const list = sorted();
    wrap.value = list;
    const head = cols.map(c => {
      const on = sortState.key === c.key;
      const aria = on ? (sortState.dir === 1 ? "ascending" : "descending") : null;
      const th = htl.html`<th scope="col" class=${c.decimals === null ? null : "n"} aria-sort=${aria}>
        <button type="button">${c.label}${on ? htl.svg`<svg class=${sortState.dir === 1 ? "ico sort up" : "ico sort"} aria-hidden="true"><use href="#chevron-down"/></svg>` : null}</button></th>`;
      th.querySelector("button").onclick = () => {
        sortState.dir = on ? -sortState.dir : (c.key === "month" ? -1 : 1);
        sortState.key = c.key;
        draw();
        wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
      };
      return th;
    });
    const table = htl.html`<table class="records" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
      <caption class="visually-hidden">Monthly records; select a column heading to sort</caption>
      <thead><tr>${head}</tr></thead>
      <tbody>${list.map(r => htl.html`<tr>${cols.map(c =>
        htl.html`<td class=${c.decimals === null ? null : "n"}>${fmtCell(r[c.key], c)}</td>`)}</tr>`)}</tbody>
    </table>`;
    wrap.replaceChildren(table);
  };
  draw();
  return wrap;
}
```
